text:
You need a Business Development Assistant who can research prospects, pursue leads, set meetings, and keep prospects moving through the sales process without losing momentum.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. That combination makes me useful not just for reporting, but for the kind of organized, detail-oriented follow-up business development work requires.

What I would bring to True Synergy is a structured, reliable approach to prospect research and pipeline support. I’m comfortable working through lists, cleaning and organizing data, spotting gaps, and turning messy information into something usable for outreach and decision-making. I also understand the importance of keeping materials clear and professional, which would be helpful when assisting with proposals and supporting the CEO’s outreach.

A project that reflects this is my Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model that replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was a much smoother reporting process, with monthly close reporting reduced from 3 days to 4 hours. That work required careful organization, accuracy, and the ability to make data easy to act on, which translates well to managing prospect information and sales follow-up.

I also worked on a GA4 migration and tracking plan for Verdant Skincare. I built the tracking plan and GTM setup to move the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4 before the cut-off. The result was 46 events mapped with no gap in year-on-year reporting. That project strengthened my ability to handle detailed tracking, maintain continuity, and keep important processes on schedule.

If you’re looking for someone who is tenacious, detail-oriented, and comfortable supporting a sales process with strong data discipline, I’d be glad to help. I can assist with prospect research, lead tracking, meeting coordination, and proposal support while helping keep your pipeline organized and moving forward.
